## 4 Estimates for the Second Model System

In this section we prove Theorem 1.2, obtaining estimates for solutions of the second model system at $\tau\in(0,1)$ in terms of the solution at $\tau=1.$ We also prove estimates for the asymptotic data at $\mathcal{I}^{-}.$ We follow the steps outlined in the Section 1.1.4 of the Introduction, and we advise the reader to refer to this section for assistance while reading the proof below.

To complete the statement of Theorem 1.2, we first define in detail the energy $\mathcal{E}_{II}$ of the solution on $S_{\tau}:$

$$ \displaystyle\mathcal{E}_{II}(\tau)= \displaystyle\tau\big\|\Phi_{0}\big\|_{H^{M+1/2}}^{2}+\tau^{2}\big\|\Phi_{0}\big\|_{H^{M+3/2}}^{2}+\tau^{2}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{M}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}+\sum_{m=0}^{M-1}\tau^{2}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\Phi_{0}\big\|_{H^{M+1}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime} \displaystyle+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\big\|\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{M+3/2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\sum_{m=0}^{M}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\sum_{m=0}^{M}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

In Section 4.1, we prove estimates for the regular quantities $\Phi_{1},\ldots,\Phi_{I}$ which satisfy the equations (1.8) with $\sigma=2$ and decouple from the singular quantity $\Phi_{0}.$ We prove (1.25) and (1.26) in Proposition 4.1. In Section 4.2, we prove the preliminary bound (1.27) in Proposition 4.2. In Section 4.3, we prove the low frequency regime estimates in Propositions 4.3 and 4.4. In Section 4.4, we prove the preliminary high frequency regime estimate in Proposition 4.5. We improve this in Section 4.5 to obtain the high frequency regime estimate in Proposition 4.6. Combining the previous estimates in Section 4.6, we complete the proof of the main estimate (1.13) in Theorem 1.2. Finally, we establish the estimates (1.14) and (1.15) for the asymptotic data at $\mathcal{I}^{-}$ in Section 4.7. We prove (1.28) in Proposition 4.7 and (1.29) in Proposition 4.8.

Notation. Unless otherwise noted, in this section we write $A\lesssim B$ for some quantities $A,B>0$ if there exists a constant $C>0$ depending only on the constants $M,C_{0},C_{2}$ defined in the Introduction, such that $A\leq CB.$

We point out that the main difficulty in our argument is dealing with the top order quantity $\xi=\nabla^{M}\Phi_{0}.$ For this part we use as a guideline the toy problem considered in [Cic24, Section 9], where we studied the equation satisfied by $\xi=\nabla^{M}\Phi_{0},$ but we dropped the terms $F^{\prime}_{M}=F_{M}^{0}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\psi\nabla^{M+1}\Phi_{i}$ for simplicity.

### 4.1 Estimates for the regular quantities

In this section, we prove the main estimates for all the regular quantities $\Phi_{i}$ , with $1\leq i\leq I:$

#### Proposition 4.1.

For all $0\leq m\leq M$ and $1\leq i\leq I$ we have:

$$ \big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{3/2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim $$

$$ \lesssim\sum_{j=1}^{I}\bigg(\big\|\Phi_{j}\big\|_{H^{m+3/2}}^{2}\big|_{\tau=1}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\Phi_{j}\big\|_{H^{m+1/2}}^{2}\big|_{\tau=1}+\sum_{k=0}^{m}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{k}^{j}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\bigg)\lesssim\mathcal{D}_{II}+\mathcal{F}_{II}(\tau). $$

#### Proof.

For the purpose of this proof we fix $0\leq m\leq M$ and we denote $\xi_{i}=\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}.$ We can rewrite (1.8) with $\sigma=2$ for all $1\leq i\leq I:$

$$ \nabla_{\tau}\big(\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big)-\frac{1}{\tau}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}-4\Delta\xi_{i}=\sum_{j=1}^{I}\psi\nabla\xi_{j}+F_{m}^{i}. $$

#### Preliminary estimates.

We first prove the following preliminary estimates for all $1\leq i\leq I:$

$$ \big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\sum_{j=1}^{I}\bigg(\big\|\Phi_{j}\big\|_{H^{m+1}}^{2}\big|_{\tau=1}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\Phi_{j}\big\|_{H^{m}}^{2}\big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{m}^{j}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg). $$

To prove this, we contract each equation (4.2) by $\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}.$ Using Lemma 3.1, we obtain the energy estimate:

$$ \big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|[\nabla,\nabla_{4}]\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\nabla\xi_{j}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We use Cauchy-Schwarz, Gronwall, and the bulk term to obtain:

$$ \big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\nabla\xi_{j}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

On the other hand, we also have the bound:

$$ \big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We sum the last two inequalities for all $1\leq i\leq I:$

$$ \sum_{i=1}^{I}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\sum_{i=1}^{I}\Big(\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We use Gronwall to complete the proof of the above preliminary estimate. For the data terms at $\tau=1$ we also use the commutation formula (2.12) and the assumption on the background spacetime $\|\psi\|_{H^{M+1}(S_{1})}\leq C_{2}$ .

#### The main estimates.

For each $k\geq 0$ , we apply $P_{k}$ to equation (4.2) to obtain:

$$ \nabla_{\tau}\big(P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big)-\frac{1}{\tau}P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}-4\Delta P_{k}\xi_{i}=\sum_{j=1}^{I}P_{k}\big(\psi\nabla\xi_{j}\big)+P_{k}F_{m}^{i}+[\nabla_{\tau},P_{k}]\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}. $$

We contract each equation by $P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i},$ in order to obtain the energy estimate:

$$ \big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\nabla[P_{k},\nabla_{4}]\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|[\nabla,\nabla_{4}]P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime} $$

$$ +\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|P_{k}(\psi\nabla\xi_{j})\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|P_{k}F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|[\nabla_{\tau},P_{k}]\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We use Cauchy-Schwarz and Gronwall to obtain:

$$ \big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|\nabla[P_{k},\nabla_{4}]\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|[P_{k},\psi]\nabla\xi_{j}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|P_{k}\nabla\xi_{j}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|[\nabla_{4},P_{k}]\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We use Lemma 2.3 and Lemma 2.4 to get:

$$ \big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{-2k}\big\|\xi_{j}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{j=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|P_{k}\nabla\xi_{j}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{-2k}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We multiply each inequality by $2^{k}$ and sum for all $1\leq i\leq I:$

$$ \sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{k}}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\Big(\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1} $$

$$ +\sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{-k}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}2^{k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{-k}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We then sum for all $k\geq 0,$ using the preliminary estimate as well to obtain:

$$ \sum_{i=1}^{I}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{3/2}}^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\sum_{i=1}^{I}\Big(\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{3/2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{3/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{m}^{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\sum_{i=1}^{I}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{i}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We use Gronwall and we bound the initial data term at $\tau=1$ as before (using $C_{2}$ ) to obtain the conclusion. ∎

### 4.2 Preliminary estimates for the singular quantities

For every $0\leq m\leq M$ , we write the equation (1.7) for $\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}$ as:

$$ \nabla_{\tau}\big(\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}\big)+\frac{1}{\tau}\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}-4\Delta\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}=\psi\nabla^{m+1}\Phi_{0}+F_{m}^{\prime}, $$

where we denote $F_{m}^{\prime}=\psi\sum_{i=1}^{I}\nabla^{m+1}\Phi_{i}+F_{m}^{0}.$ We prove the preliminary estimate (1.27) as outlined in Section 1.1.4 of the Introduction:

#### Proposition 4.2.

For all $0\leq m\leq M$ and $\tau\in[0,1]$ we have the estimates:

$$ \displaystyle\big\|\tau\nabla_{\tau}\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla^{m+1}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\tau\big\|\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla^{m+1}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim \displaystyle\lesssim\bigg(\big\|\Phi_{0}\big\|_{H^{m+3/2}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\Phi_{0}\big\|_{H^{m+1/2}}^{2}\bigg)\bigg|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{m}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

#### Proof.

For the purpose of this proof, we denote $\xi_{m}=\nabla^{m}\Phi_{0}.$ We can rewrite equation (4.3) as:

$$ \nabla_{\tau}\big(\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big)-4\tau\Delta\xi_{m}=\tau\psi\nabla\xi_{m}+\tau F_{m}^{\prime}. $$

Using Lemma 3.1, we obtain the energy estimate:

$$ \big\|\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1} $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}\Big(\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}+(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|[\nabla,\nabla_{4}]\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}\Big)d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{m}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

Using Gronwall, we obtain:

$$ \big\|\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{4}\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{m}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}. $$

Similarly, we have the estimate:

$$ \big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

In particular, this implies:

$$ \tau^{4}\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{4}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}, $$

which gives in the above inequality:

$$ \big\|\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{4}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{m}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

By Gronwall, we obtain:

$$ \big\|\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{m}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

Using this, we also have:

$$ \tau\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}\lesssim\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\sqrt{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{3/2}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2} $$

$$ \lesssim\Big(\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\bigg)\Big|_{\tau=1}+\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{m}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\sqrt{\tau^{\prime}}\big\|\xi_{m}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We obtain the conclusion using Gronwall and bounding the initial data term at $\tau=1$ . ∎

### 4.3 Low frequency regime estimates

For the rest of Section 4, we denote the top order term $\xi=\nabla^{M}\Phi_{0}.$ We write (1.7) as:

$$ \nabla_{\tau}\big(\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big)+\frac{1}{\tau}\nabla_{\tau}\xi-4\Delta\xi=\psi\nabla\xi+F_{M}^{\prime}, $$

where we denote $F_{M}^{\prime}=\psi\sum_{i=1}^{I}\nabla^{M+1}\Phi_{i}+F_{M}^{0}.$

As outlined in Section 1.1.4 of the Introduction, we consider $X=2^{x+1}$ to be a large constant, to be chosen later depending only on $M,C_{0},C_{2}.$ We consider the following regimes:

- • Negative frequencies $k<0$ ;

- • Low frequency regime $0\leq k<x$ for all $\tau\in[0,1]$ ;

- • Low frequency regime $k\geq x$ for $\tau\in[0,X2^{-k-1}]$ ;

- • High frequency regime $k\geq x$ for $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ .

Notation. In addition to our previous notation convention, we write $A\lesssim_{X}B$ for some quantities $A,B>0$ if there exists a constant $C>0$ depending only on the constants $M,C_{0},C_{2}$ and $X$ , such that $A\leq CB.$ Otherwise, if we write $A\lesssim B$ then the implicit constant $C$ is independent of $X$ .

In order to deal with the negative frequencies, we can simply use the preliminary estimate (1.27). Similarly, we have the following bound in the low frequency regime $0\leq k<x$ :

#### Proposition 4.3.

For $0\leq k<x$ , we have the low frequency regime estimate for all $\tau\in[0,1]$ :

$$ \big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim_{X}2^{-3k}\mathcal{D}_{II}+2^{-3k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

#### Proof.

Since $0\leq k<x,$ we have using the preliminary estimate in Proposition 4.2:

$$ \big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim_{X}2^{-3k}\Big(\big\|\tau\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\Big)\lesssim_{X}2^{-3k}\mathcal{D}_{II}+2^{-3k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

∎

We prove the main estimate in the low frequency regime $k\geq x$ for $\tau\in[0,X2^{-k-1}]$ . The idea is to prove a similar estimate to (1.27) for $P_{k}\xi.$ We note that we follow the argument for the toy problem in [Cic24, Section 9], while keeping track of the inhomogeneous terms.

#### Proposition 4.4.

For any $0\leq\tau<X2^{-k-1}\leq 1$ we have the low frequency regime estimate:

$$ \displaystyle\big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim \displaystyle X^{2}2^{-2k}\Big(\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\Big)\Big|_{\tau=X2^{-k-1}}+C_{X}2^{-3k}\mathcal{D}_{II}+ \displaystyle+C_{X}2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+C_{X}2^{-3k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

#### Proof.

We apply $P_{k}$ to (4.4) to obtain for any $k\geq x$ :

$$ \nabla_{\tau}\big(\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big)-4\tau\Delta P_{k}\xi=\tau P_{k}\big(\psi\nabla\xi\big)+\tau P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}+[\nabla_{\tau},P_{k}]\tau\nabla_{\tau}\xi. $$

We contract the equation with $\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi$ and integrate by parts to obtain the following energy estimate:

$$ \big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim $$

$$ \lesssim X^{2}2^{-2k}\Big(\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\Big)\Big|_{X2^{-k-1}}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|\nabla[P_{k},\nabla_{4}]\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|[\nabla,\nabla_{4}]P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|P_{k}\big(\psi\nabla\xi\big)\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|[P_{k},\nabla_{4}]\tau^{\prime}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We point out that similarly to the proof of Proposition 4.2, we obtain a bulk term with a favorable sign, which we drop. We use Lemma 2.3 to bound the commutation terms:

$$ \displaystyle\big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim X^{2}2^{-2k}\Big(\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\Big)\Big|_{X2^{-k-1}}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}d\tau^{\prime} \displaystyle+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}2^{-k}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}d\tau^{\prime}+ \displaystyle+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

Using Cauchy-Schwarz, we obtain the bound:

$$ \big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim X^{2}2^{-2k}\Big(\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\Big)\Big|_{X2^{-k-1}}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}\frac{2^{k}}{X}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}\frac{2^{k}}{X}\big\|\tau^{\prime}P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+C_{X}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}2^{-3k}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +C_{X}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}2^{-k}(\tau^{\prime})^{4}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+2^{-k}C_{X}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

Using the Gronwall inequality for $\tau\leq X2^{-k-1}\leq 1$ we get:

$$ \big\|\tau\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\big\|\tau P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim X^{2}2^{-2k}\Big(\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\Big)\Big|_{X2^{-k-1}}+ $$

$$ +C_{X}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}2^{-3k}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+C_{X}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}2^{-k}(\tau^{\prime})^{4}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+2^{-k}C_{X}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-k-1}}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}. $$

Finally, we use the above estimate (1.27) to complete the proof. ∎

### 4.4 High frequency regime estimates

In this section, we prove a high frequency regime estimate for the top order term $\xi=\nabla^{M}\Phi_{0}.$ The proof is similar to that of Proposition 3.9, but in the current case the bulk term has an unfavorable sign, which will create several complications in Section 4.5. Moreover, it is essential that the implicit constant in the estimate obtained is independent of the parameter $X.$

#### Proposition 4.5.

$\xi$ satisfies the high frequency regime estimate for any $\tau\in\big[X2^{-k-1},1\big]:$

$$ 2^{k}\tau\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{2^{k}}{\tau}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+2^{k}\tau\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\lesssim\bigg(2^{k}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+2^{k}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+2^{k}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\bigg)\bigg|_{\tau=1} $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}(\tau^{\prime})^{3}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{\tau^{\prime}}{2^{k}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}{2^{k}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F^{\prime}_{M}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

#### Proof.

We introduce the new time variable $t=X^{-1}2^{k}\tau\in[1/2,X^{-1}2^{k}]$ . The equation (4.4) becomes:

$$ \nabla_{t}\big(\nabla_{t}\xi\big)+\frac{1}{t}\nabla_{t}\xi-4\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\cdot\Delta\xi=\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\cdot\psi\nabla\xi+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\cdot F_{M}^{\prime}. $$

We multiply by $\sqrt{t}$ to get:

$$ \nabla_{t}\big(\nabla_{t}(\xi\sqrt{t})\big)+\frac{1}{4t^{2}}\xi\sqrt{t}-4\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\cdot\Delta\xi\sqrt{t}=\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\cdot\psi\nabla\xi\sqrt{t}+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\cdot F_{M}^{\prime}\sqrt{t}. $$

We apply $P_{k}$ to the equation:

$$ \displaystyle\nabla_{t}\big(P_{k}\nabla_{t}(\xi\sqrt{t})\big)+\frac{1}{4t^{2}}P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}-4\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\Delta P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}= \displaystyle\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\psi\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\psi[P_{k},\nabla]\xi\sqrt{t}+ \displaystyle+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}[P_{k},\psi]\nabla\xi\sqrt{t}+\frac{X^{2}P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\sqrt{t}}{2^{2k}}+[\nabla_{t},P_{k}]\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t}. $$

We contract the equation with $P_{k}\nabla_{t}(\xi\sqrt{t})$ and integrate by parts. We notice that using the analogue of Lemma 3.3 for the new time variable $t$ does not introduce any constants that depend on $X.$ We obtain the energy estimate:

$$ \big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{1}{t^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\lesssim $$

$$ \lesssim\bigg(X^{-1}2^{k}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X}{2^{k}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X}{2^{k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\bigg)\bigg|_{t=X^{-1}2^{k}}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{1}{(t^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{1}{(t^{\prime})^{2}}\big|P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big|\cdot\big|[P_{k},\nabla_{t}]\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|\nabla[P_{k},\nabla_{t}]\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|[\nabla,\nabla_{t}]P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|[P_{k},\nabla]\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|[P_{k},\psi]\nabla\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\int_{S^{n}}\big|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|\cdot\big|[\nabla_{t},P_{k}]\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big|dt^{\prime}. $$

We use Lemma 2.4, and Gronwall for $t\in\big[1/2,X^{-1}2^{k}\big]$ (to deal with the fifth and sixth error terms):

$$ \big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{1}{t^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\lesssim $$

$$ \lesssim\bigg(X^{-1}2^{k}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X}{2^{k}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X}{2^{k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\bigg)\bigg|_{t=X^{-1}2^{k}}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{1}{(t^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}t^{\prime}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\Big(\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}+2^{-k}\big\|\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\Big)dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{4}t^{\prime}}{2^{4k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\bigg(\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}+2^{-k}\big\|\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{H^{1}}\bigg)+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{3k}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{3k}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\cdot\big\|\nabla\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{2}t^{\prime}}{2^{2k}}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\Big(\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}+2^{-k}\big\|\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}\Big)dt^{\prime}. $$

We use Gronwall for $t\in\big[1/2,X^{-1}2^{k}\big]$ to get:

$$ \big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{1}{t^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X^{2}}{2^{2k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\sqrt{t}\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\lesssim $$

$$ \lesssim\bigg(X^{-1}2^{k}\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X}{2^{k}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{X}{2^{k}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}\bigg)\bigg|_{t=X^{-1}2^{k}}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{1}{(t^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{3}}{2^{3k}}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{5}(t^{\prime})^{2}}{2^{5k}}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{3}(t^{\prime})^{2}}{2^{3k}}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla_{t}\xi\sqrt{t^{\prime}}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{3}t^{\prime}}{2^{5k}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{3}(t^{\prime})^{3}}{2^{5k}}\big\|\nabla_{t}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}+\int_{t}^{X^{-1}2^{k}}\frac{X^{3}t^{\prime}}{2^{3k}}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}dt^{\prime}. $$

We change variables to $\tau$ and we obtain the conclusion. ∎

### 4.5 Improved high frequency estimates

The goal of this section is to improve the high frequency regime estimate of Proposition 4.5 in order to prove estimates in the high frequency regime only in terms of data and the inhomogeneous terms.

#### Proposition 4.6.

We denote by $\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}$ the characteristic function of $\{1\geq\tau\geq X2^{-k-1}\},$ and we denote:

$$ a_{k}(\tau):=\tau\big\|P_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\frac{1}{\tau}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}+\tau\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|^{2}_{L^{2}}. $$

We have the improved high frequency estimate for any $\tau\in(0,1]$ :

$$ \sum_{\tau\geq X2^{-k-1}}2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\lesssim\mathcal{D}_{II}+\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

The rest of this section is dedicated to the proof of this proposition. We follow the detailed outline of the proof from Section 1.1.4 of the Introduction, and we divide the proof into multiple steps. We note that the proof is very similar to the toy problem considered in [Cic24, Section 9], but in the current case we also need to keep track of the inhomogeneous terms. Additionally, in the present proof we fill in several of the details that we omitted in [Cic24], such as the proof of the Gronwall-like inequality in Lemma 4.1.

Throughout the proof we use the schematic notation $\{d_{k}\}_{k\geq 0}$ for data terms at $\tau=1$ which satisfy:

$$ \sum_{k\geq 0}d_{k}\lesssim\mathcal{D}_{II}. $$

#### Consequences of Proposition 4.5.

The starting point is the preliminary high frequency regime estimate in Proposition 4.5. Using the above notation, we have for all $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ :

$$ 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\lesssim 2^{k}a_{k}(1)+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}e_{k}(\tau^{\prime})+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\overline{e_{k}}(\tau^{\prime})+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}, $$

where we define the energies:

$$ \displaystyle e_{k} \displaystyle=2^{k}\tau^{3}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+2^{k}\tau^{3}\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}, \displaystyle\overline{e_{k}} \displaystyle=2^{k}\tau\big\|\underline{\widetilde{P}}_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\frac{\tau}{2^{k}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{H^{1}}^{2}+\frac{\tau^{3}}{2^{k}}\big\|\nabla_{\tau}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}. $$

The error term containing $e_{k}$ is similar to the error terms with different projection operators of Section 3, as explained in Section 1.1.4. We deal with these terms towards the end of our argument, when summing the estimates obtained for all $k\geq x.$ In the meantime we simply keep track of these terms, similarly to the inhomogeneous terms.

On the other hand, we can already bound the error terms containing $\overline{e_{k}}$ using the preliminary estimate in Proposition 4.2. We can bound the first term in $\overline{e_{k}}$ by the second term, using the finite band property for LP projections. We then apply (1.27) to get:

$$ \int_{\tau}^{1}\overline{e_{k}}(\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim_{X}d_{k}+2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

As a consequence, we proved that for all $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ we have the high frequency regime estimate:

$$ 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\lesssim C_{X}d_{k}+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}e_{k}(\tau^{\prime})+C_{X}2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}. $$

#### Applying the refined Poincaré inequality.

According to Section 1.1.4 of the Introduction, the second error term in the above estimate causes significant challenges. We also explained in Section 1.1.2 that we could not bound this term directly using the finite band property for LP projections. Instead, we use the refined Poincaré inequality for LP projections (2.28). As a result, we have for all $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ and $\delta>0$ :

$$ \int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim\frac{1}{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{-k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|\nabla P_{k}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\delta\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\sum_{l=0}^{k-1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\frac{1}{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{-3k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

The last term in this inequality is bounded using the preliminary estimate (1.27):

$$ \int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{-3k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\big\|\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim_{X}2^{-k}\mathcal{D}_{II}+2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

As a result, there exist constants $C^{\prime},C_{X},C_{X,\delta}>0$ such that for all $k\geq x$ and $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ :

$$ 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\leq C_{X,\delta}d_{k}+\frac{C^{\prime}}{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{-2k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}\cdot 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}+C^{\prime}\delta\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\sum_{l=0}^{k-1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +C_{X,\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}e_{k}(\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}+C_{X,\delta}2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+C_{X,\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We can deal with the second error term by using Gronwall for $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ . We compute:

$$ \exp\bigg(\frac{C^{\prime}}{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{2^{-2k}}{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}d\tau^{\prime}\bigg)\leq\exp\bigg(\frac{C^{\prime}}{\delta}\cdot\frac{1}{X^{2}}\bigg)\leq 2, $$

where we fix $X>0$ large enough, depending on $C^{\prime}$ and $\delta$ , such that:

$$ \frac{C^{\prime}}{\delta}\cdot\frac{1}{X^{2}}\leq\log(2). $$

Therefore, we have for all $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ :

$$ 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\leq C_{\delta}d_{k}+2C^{\prime}\delta\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{2}}\sum_{l=0}^{k-1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+C_{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}e_{k}(\tau^{\prime})+C_{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{-k}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}+2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}. $$

#### Bounding the low frequency regime error terms.

As a consequence of the refined Poincaré inequality, the second term in the above has both a low frequency regime and a high frequency regime part. We want to separate these two, and apply the low frequency regime estimates in Section 4.3. This process creates a sum of discrete error terms which pose additional difficulties. We notice that we can write:

$$ \mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}\sum_{l=0}^{k-1}2^{-8k+7l}\tau^{\prime}\big\|\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}\leq\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}\sum_{l=x}^{k-1}2^{-8k+6l}\cdot 2^{l}a_{l}(\tau^{\prime})\mathbf{1}_{l,\tau^{\prime}}d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{4}}\sum_{l=0}^{x-1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{4}}\sum_{\tau^{\prime}<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}, $$

where the first term is in the high frequency regime and the last two terms are in the low frequency regime. We use Proposition 4.3 to obtain:

$$ \mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{4}}\sum_{l=0}^{x-1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim_{X}\mathcal{D}_{II}\cdot\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\frac{2^{-8k}}{\tau^{7}}+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\frac{2^{-8k}}{\tau^{7}}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}\lesssim_{X}d_{k}+2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}. $$

Similarly, we use Proposition 4.4 to obtain:

$$ \mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{4}}\sum_{\tau^{\prime}<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}=\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\sum_{\tau<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-l-1}}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{4}}2^{-8k+7l}\big\|\tau^{\prime}\nabla P_{l}\xi\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime} $$

$$ \lesssim\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}X\sum_{\tau<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}\frac{2^{-8k+6l}}{\tau^{3}}a_{l}(X2^{-l-1})+C_{X}\mathcal{D}_{II}\cdot\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\frac{2^{-8k}}{\tau^{7}}+ $$

$$ +C_{X}\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\frac{2^{-8k}}{\tau^{7}}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+C_{X}\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\frac{2^{-8k}}{\tau^{7}}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

We notice that in the above estimate the last term is obtained by bounding:

$$ \sum_{\tau<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}\int_{\tau}^{X2^{-l-1}}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{4}}2^{-8k+6l}\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{X2^{-l-1}}\tilde{\tau}^{2}\big\|P_{l}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tilde{\tau}d\tau^{\prime}\lesssim_{X}\sum_{\tau<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}\frac{1}{\tau^{3}}2^{-8k+4l}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tilde{\tau}2^{l}\big\|P_{l}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tilde{\tau}. $$

As a result, we proved that there exist constants $C^{\prime\prime},C_{\delta}>0$ such that for all $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ :

$$ 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\leq C_{\delta}d_{k}+C^{\prime\prime}\delta\cdot\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}\sum_{l=x}^{k-1}2^{-8k+6l}\cdot 2^{l}a_{l}(\tau^{\prime})\mathbf{1}_{l,\tau^{\prime}}d\tau^{\prime}+C^{\prime\prime}\delta X\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\sum_{\tau<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}\frac{2^{-8k+6l}}{\tau^{3}}a_{l}(X2^{-l-1}) $$

$$ +C_{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}e_{k}(\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}+C_{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+C_{\delta}2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}(\tau^{\prime})^{2}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+C_{\delta}2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

#### Gronwall-like inequality.

Our next goal is to deal with the second term in the above estimate using a suitable Gronwall-like inequality. We set-up the problem in order to isolate this error term. We consider $\delta>0$ to be small enough, so that:

$$ C^{\prime\prime}\delta<\frac{1}{10}. $$

We introduce some notation for the error terms on the right hand side of the above estimate:

$$ \displaystyle S_{k}(\tau) \displaystyle=\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}C^{\prime\prime}\delta X\sum_{\tau<X2^{-l-1}\leq 1}\frac{2^{-8k+6l}}{\tau^{3}}a_{l}(X2^{-l-1}), \displaystyle E_{k}(\tau) \displaystyle=\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}C_{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}e_{k}(\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}, \displaystyle I_{k}(\tau) \displaystyle=\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}C_{\delta}2^{-k}\int_{\tau}^{1}\tau^{\prime}\big\|F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{H^{1/2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}+\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}C_{\delta}\int_{\tau}^{1}2^{k}\tau^{\prime}\big\|P_{k}F_{M}^{\prime}\big\|_{L^{2}}^{2}d\tau^{\prime}, \displaystyle A_{k}(\tau) \displaystyle=C_{\delta}d_{k}+S_{k}(\tau)+E_{k}(\tau)+I_{k}(\tau). $$

Using this notation, we have that for all $k\geq x$ and $\tau\in[X2^{-k-1},1]$ :

$$ 2^{k}a_{k}(\tau)\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\leq A_{k}(\tau)+\frac{1}{10}\cdot\mathbf{1}_{k,\tau}\int_{\tau}^{1}\frac{1}{(\tau^{\prime})^{3}}\sum_{l=x}^{k-1}2^{-8k+6l}\cdot 2^{l}a_{l}(\tau^{\prime})\mathbf{1}_{l,\tau^{\prime}}d\tau^{\prime}. $$

This motivates us to prove the following Gronwall-like lemma:

#### Lemma 4.1.

We consider the functions $u,A,b,c:\mathbb{N}\times[0,1]\rightarrow[0,\infty),$ which for all $k\geq x,\ \tau\in(0,1]$ satisfy the inequality:

$$ u(k,\tau)\leq A(k,\tau)+b(k)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k-1}c(l,\tau^{\prime})u(l,\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime} $$

Then, we have that for all $k\geq x,\ \tau\in(0,1]$ :

$$ u(k,\tau)\leq A(k,\tau)+b(k)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k-1}c(l,\tau^{\prime})A(l,\tau^{\prime})\prod_{j=l+1}^{k-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tau^{\prime\prime})d\tau^{\prime\prime}\bigg)d\tau^{\prime}. $$

#### Proof.

We prove this by induction on $k.$ In the case $k=x,$ we have from (4.9) that $u(x,\tau)\leq A(x,\tau)$ as desired. Next, we assume that (4.10) holds for $x,x+1,\ldots,k$ and we prove it for $k+1.$ We have:

$$ u(k+1,\tau)\leq A(k+1,\tau)+b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})u(l,\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime} $$

$$ \leq A(k+1,\tau)+b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})\bigg\{A(l,\tau^{\prime})+b(l)\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{1}\sum_{i=x}^{l-1}c(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})A(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})\prod_{j=i+1}^{l-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})\bigg)d\tau^{\prime\prime}\bigg\}d\tau^{\prime} $$

$$ \leq A(k+1,\tau)+b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})A(l,\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k}\sum_{i=x}^{l-1}\bigg\{c(l,\tau^{\prime})b(l)c(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})A(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})\prod_{j=i+1}^{l-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})d\tilde{\tau}\bigg)\bigg\}d\tau^{\prime\prime}d\tau^{\prime} $$

$$ \leq A(k+1,\tau)+b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})A(l,\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}\sum_{i=x}^{k-1}\sum_{l=i+1}^{k}\bigg\{c(l,\tau^{\prime})b(l)c(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})A(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})\prod_{j=i+1}^{l-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})d\tilde{\tau}\bigg)\bigg\}d\tau^{\prime}d\tau^{\prime\prime} $$

$$ \leq A(k+1,\tau)+b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{l=x}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})A(l,\tau^{\prime})d\tau^{\prime}+ $$

$$ +b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{i=x}^{k-1}c(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})A(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})\bigg\{\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}\sum_{l=i+1}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})b(l)\prod_{j=i+1}^{l-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau^{\prime}}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})d\tilde{\tau}\bigg)d\tau^{\prime}\bigg\}d\tau^{\prime\prime} $$

$$ \leq A(k+1,\tau)+b(k+1)\int_{\tau}^{1}\sum_{i=x}^{k}c(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})A(i,\tau^{\prime\prime})\bigg\{1+\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}\sum_{l=i+1}^{k}c(l,\tau^{\prime})b(l)\prod_{j=i+1}^{l-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})d\tilde{\tau}\bigg)d\tau^{\prime}\bigg\}d\tau^{\prime\prime} $$

We conclude, since we have:

$$ 1+\sum_{l=i+1}^{k}\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}c(l,\tau^{\prime})b(l)d\tau^{\prime}\cdot\prod_{j=i+1}^{l-1}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})d\tilde{\tau}\bigg)=\prod_{j=i+1}^{k}\bigg(1+\int_{\tau}^{\tau^{\prime\prime}}b(j)c(j,\tilde{\tau})d\tilde{\tau}\bigg). $$
